title: Soil Sample DNA Extraction Using SuperSoil
author: Hsin-Mao Wu

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Lysis Reagents
steps.instruction: Combine sample and lysis components in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g sample, 800 µL SD1 solution, 0.2 mL ⌀=1.0 mm zirconia beads, and 0.2 mL ⌀=0.5 mm zirconia beads to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Vortex briefly to mix.
If SD1 solution is precipitated, leave at room temperature for 30 minutes until transparent.
If soil is too loose to fit in one tube, divide between 2 microcentrifuge tubes for downstream workflow (these must be merged at the final step).

steps.title: Optional Lysis Enhancement
steps.instruction: If the sample is hard to lyse, apply one of the following modifications:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes after adding SD1 solution.
Add 3 additional stainless steel beads and use 2.0 ml screw vials instead of microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the sample using a Vortex-Genie® 2 with an SI-H524 Horizontal microtube holder.

substeps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 4 minutes.
Carefully remove the tube by pressing the lid and slowly loosening the tube with the other hand.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate Inhibitory Substances
steps.instruction: Treat the supernatant with SD2 solution to remove inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SD2 solution to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant from the previous step into the tube containing SD2.
Vortex for 5 seconds to mix (a white precipitate should form).
If suspended substances remain, use a P200 pipette set to 150 μl to suck up the supernatant 3 times.

steps.title: Second Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Lysate for Column
steps.instruction: Treat the supernatant with SD3 solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL SD3 solution to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 700 µL of the supernatant from the previous step into the SD3 tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds to mix.
If Solution CD3 has precipitated, heat at 60 °C until dissolved.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the lysate onto a spin column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 650 µL of the mixture to a spin column (with collection tube).
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.
Discard the flow-through and repeat the centrifugation step to ensure all lysates have passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash Column with Solution SEA
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA using Solution SEA.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column into a clean 2 ml collection tube, avoiding splashing flow-through onto the column.
Add 500 µL of Solution SEA to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.
Discard the flow-through and return the spin column to the same 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Wash Column with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA using 80% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL 80% ethanol to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.
Discard the flow-through and place the spin column into a new 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Dry the Spin Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 3 minutes.
Carefully place the spin column into a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL RNase-free water (DEPC-treated water) or TE (Tris-EDTA) buffer to the center of the white filter membrane.
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm and 25 °C for 2 minutes.
Discard the spin column; the DNA is now in the microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the quality and quantity of the specimens using BioTek Take3 & Take3 Trio Microvolume Plates.
